website.note: Commercial insulin pump (MODD1) FDA-cleared Sep 2024; no clinical pipeline page.

MODD1.indication: Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes mellitus insulin delivery

Pivot.type: Tubeless insulin pump with CGM integration (next-gen MODD1)
Pivot.regulatory_status: FDA 510(k) submission planned (fiscal year ending March 31, 2026)
Pivot.indication: Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes insulin delivery
Pivot.note: Intended to replace MODD1 once cleared.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical device company (Class II insulin pump). MODD1 is FDA-cleared and commercial; successor Pivot is in regulatory submission pathway (510(k)), not a drug clinical trial. No active P1/P2/P3 drug studies.
